parts.name: bottle shell

physics.Basic_description: Translucent white plastic bottle body with a cylindrical lower section tapering to a neck, featuring a smooth matte finish.
physics.Functional_description: Main container reservoir for holding liquid contents.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the cylindrical mid-section of the bottle body with a parallel jaw gripper for stable manipulation.
physics.reason: Standard blow-molded plastic bottle construction implies a thin shell enclosing air or liquid volume.

parts.description: Translucent white plastic bottle body with a cylindrical lower section tapering to a neck, featuring a smooth matte finish.
parts.function: Main container reservoir for holding liquid contents.

parts.name: front label

physics.Basic_description: Small rectangular pale green label adhered to the lower front surface of the bottle.
physics.Functional_description: Displays product branding or usage information.
physics.Grasped_description: Too thin and flat to be grasped independently; would be contacted incidentally when grasping the bottle body.
physics.reason: A paper label is a thin solid sheet of material without an enclosed void.

parts.description: Small rectangular pale green label adhered to the lower front surface of the bottle.
parts.function: Displays product branding or usage information.

parts.name: liquid fill

physics.Basic_description: Internal volume representing the liquid contents, visualized as blue regions within the bottle segmentation.
physics.Functional_description: The actual fluid product stored inside the dispenser.
physics.Grasped_description: Cannot be grasped directly as it is contained within the bottle shell.
physics.reason: Modeled as a solid volume filling the interior space, distinct from the container walls.

parts.description: Internal volume representing the liquid contents, visualized as blue regions within the bottle segmentation.
parts.function: The actual fluid product stored inside the dispenser.

parts.name: collar shell

physics.Basic_description: Yellow ribbed screw cap or collar located at the top neck of the bottle.
physics.Functional_description: Secures the pump mechanism to the bottle neck via threading.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the ribbed outer surface to twist or stabilize the pump assembly during operation.
physics.reason: Injection molded screw caps are hollow shells designed to fit over the bottle neck.

parts.description: Yellow ribbed screw cap or collar located at the top neck of the bottle.
parts.function: Secures the pump mechanism to the bottle neck via threading.

parts.name: lock ring shell

physics.Basic_description: Small plastic ring component situated between the collar and the pump head, likely orange in color.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as a locking mechanism or seal between the cap and pump stem.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and recessed to be a primary grasp target; handled indirectly via the collar or pump head.
physics.reason: Small plastic rings are typically thin-walled hollow structures.

parts.description: Small plastic ring component situated between the collar and the pump head, likely orange in color.
parts.function: Acts as a locking mechanism or seal between the cap and pump stem.

parts.name: pump head shell

physics.Basic_description: Purple plastic actuator head at the very top of the dispenser mechanism.
physics.Functional_description: Pressed by the user to dispense liquid through the internal piston mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Press down on the top surface or grasp the sides to actuate the pump.
physics.reason: Pump heads are injection molded hollow shells containing the spring and piston mechanism.

parts.description: Purple plastic actuator head at the very top of the dispenser mechanism.
parts.function: Pressed by the user to dispense liquid through the internal piston mechanism.

parts.name: dip tube

physics.Basic_description: Long, thin, flexible cyan tube extending from the bottom of the pump into the bottle.
physics.Functional_description: Draws liquid from the bottom of the bottle up to the pump mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Flexible and internal; not a stable grasp point for manipulating the object.
physics.reason: Dip tubes are thin-walled hollow pipes designed to transport fluid.

parts.description: Long, thin, flexible cyan tube extending from the bottom of the pump into the bottle.
parts.function: Draws liquid from the bottom of the bottle up to the pump mechanism.

parts.name: spout shell

physics.Basic_description: Small magenta nozzle or spout extending from the side of the pump head.
physics.Functional_description: Directs the dispensed liquid outward away from the bottle.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and fragile to grasp safely; avoid contact to prevent damage.
physics.reason: Nozzles are hollow channels molded as thin shells to allow fluid passage.

parts.description: Small magenta nozzle or spout extending from the side of the pump head.
parts.function: Directs the dispensed liquid outward away from the bottle.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
